tex_content.html:
Corollary
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0019 1. Corollary 1.11\group model-geometries

Given $x,y \in \M ^n$ and a linear isometry $f : (T_x \M ^n,g(x)) \to (T_y \M ^n,g(y))$, there exists at most one isometry $\gamma \in \Isom (\M ^n,g)$ with $\gamma (x)=y$ and $\gamma _* = f$. If $\M ^n$ is compact, then $\Isom (\M ^n,g)$ is compact.
